scope: Comprehensive test suite quality, coverage, and strategic assessment

executive_summary.verdict: CAUTIOUSLY OPTIMISTIC - Suite passes quantity/quality bars but has critical strategic gaps
executive_summary.headline: 5,804 passing tests mask 23 high-priority coverage gaps and architectural blind spots
executive_summary.key_insight: Test suite is TACTICALLY sound (unit/integration coverage) but STRATEGICALLY incomplete (core workflows untested)

findings_by_category.summary: Excellent breadth (292 files, 5,804 tests), concerning depth (core workflows missing)

issues.title: PRIMECCC WORKFLOW: Zero E2E Test Coverage
issues.description: 14 prime commands exist, only 3 test files cover them. No /primeccc E2E tests found despite CLAUDE.md stating 'RECOMMENDED' status and 93% efficiency claim.
issues.recommendation: Create tests/commands/test_primeccc_e2e.py with intent→plan→code→PR validation. Test auto-selection from backlog, --plan-only, --auto-pr flags.
issues.production_risk: HIGH - Core user-facing workflow untested

issues.title: AGENT-TO-AGENT COMMUNICATION: Untested Protocol
issues.description: 10 specialized agents communicate via context handoffs, but integration tests only cover isolated agents. No tests validate ChiefArchitect→Planner→Coder→QualityEnforcer flows.
issues.recommendation: Create tests/integration/test_agent_communication_flows.py testing: 1) ChiefArchitect audit→Planner spec, 2) Planner spec→Coder implementation, 3) Coder→QualityEnforcer validation loops.
issues.production_risk: CRITICAL - Agent communication failures would be silent

issues.title: ARTICLE IV LEARNING: VectorStore Integration Gaps
issues.description: 1,636 constitutional references exist but only 20 tests explicitly verify VectorStore query/store patterns. Article IV mandates MANDATORY usage, but enforcement is untested.
issues.recommendation: Create tests/constitutional/test_article_iv_enforcement.py validating: 1) All agents query VectorStore before decisions, 2) Patterns auto-store after success, 3) USE_ENHANCED_MEMORY=false fails constitutional audit.
issues.production_risk: MEDIUM - Learning degradation would be gradual, not immediate failure

issues.title: THREE-TIER MEMORY ARCHITECTURE: Integration Gaps
issues.description: Memory Tool (Tier 1) + VectorStore (Tier 2) + Session (Tier 3) documented in CLAUDE.md, but no tests validate cross-tier synchronization or Memory Tool file persistence.
issues.recommendation: Create tests/integration/test_three_tier_memory.py: 1) Write to Memory Tool → query VectorStore (cross-tier), 2) Session context → Memory Tool persistence, 3) Tier priority resolution.
issues.production_risk: MEDIUM - Memory inconsistencies would confuse agents

issues.title: CONSTITUTIONAL GATES: Enforcement Pipeline Untested
issues.description: Articles I-V enforcement exists in isolated tests (1,636 references) but no end-to-end pipeline test validates multi-layer enforcement (pre-commit → agent → CI → branch protection).
issues.recommendation: Create tests/e2e/test_constitutional_enforcement_pipeline.py: 1) Commit violating Article II → pre-commit blocks, 2) Agent bypass attempt → CI blocks, 3) Force push → branch protection blocks.
issues.production_risk: HIGH - Constitutional violations could slip through if one layer fails

issues.title: ERROR RECOVERY FLOWS: Partial Coverage
issues.description: Result<T,E> pattern used extensively (1,443 tests), but only 26 tests explicitly cover error recovery paths (retry, rollback, escalation).
issues.recommendation: Audit all Result.unwrap_err() usage in production code, add tests for: 1) Retry exhaustion handling, 2) Rollback on Err, 3) Error escalation to ChiefArchitect.
issues.production_risk: MEDIUM - Unhandled Err() could cause silent failures

issues.title: SPEC-DRIVEN DEVELOPMENT: Plan Execution Gap
issues.description: Article V mandates spec.md → plan.md → TodoWrite, but only 20 tests cover spec_generator and 0 tests validate plan.md → code traceability.
issues.recommendation: Create tests/integration/test_spec_driven_workflow.py: 1) Spec → Plan with traceability, 2) Plan → TodoWrite tasks, 3) TodoWrite → Code with spec_id validation.
issues.production_risk: MEDIUM - Spec drift from implementation would violate Article V

issues.title: LEAP EVOLUTION VALIDATION: Historical Gaps
issues.description: Leap 7 (TDD Autonomy) and Leap 4 (Quality Feedback) documented, but no regression tests validate Leap 3 (Adaptive Router) or Leap 1 (Foundation) remain functional.
issues.recommendation: Create tests/regression/test_leap_suite.py running all Leap E2E tests to prevent regressions in historical capabilities.
issues.production_risk: LOW - Leaps are well-documented, risk is gradual decay

findings_by_category.summary: Strong AAA pattern compliance, excellent fixture organization, some naming verbosity

issues.title: TEST NAMING VERBOSITY: 109-Character Names
issues.description: 20 test names exceed 90 characters (max found: 109). Long names reduce readability in pytest output and CI logs.
issues.recommendation: Refactor to use docstrings for context, keep names under 80 chars: test_confusion_matrix_fn_rate() with docstring explaining calculation.
issues.production_risk: LOW - Cosmetic issue, no functional impact

issues.title: DUPLICATE TEST NAMES: 16 Collisions Found
issues.description: 16 test names appear in multiple files (e.g., test_agent_creation, test_context). While isolated by file, this creates confusion in pytest output.
issues.recommendation: Prefix tests with file context: test_chief_architect_agent_creation, test_planner_agent_creation.
issues.production_risk: LOW - Cosmetic, may confuse debugging

issues.title: SLEEP USAGE IN TESTS: 30+ Instances
issues.description: 30+ time.sleep() calls found in tests (e.g., trinity_protocol integration tests with sleep(1.0)). Slows test suite unnecessarily.
issues.recommendation: Replace sleep with event-driven waits (asyncio.Event, threading.Event) or reduce to 0.01s for filesystem tests.
issues.production_risk: LOW - Performance only, no functional risk

issues.title: MOCK OVERUSE: 3,156 Mock Instances
issues.description: 3,156 mock usages detected. Heavy mocking reduces integration test value. Some tests mock 80%+ of dependencies.
issues.recommendation: Shift from unit→integration where possible. Use real implementations for shared/agent_context.py, replace mocks with in-memory backends.
issues.production_risk: MEDIUM - Mocks may not match real behavior, leading to integration failures in production

findings_by_category.summary: CATASTROPHIC GAP - Zero @pytest.mark.necessary usage despite constitutional mandate

issues.title: NECESSARY MARKERS ABSENT: 0 of 5,804 Tests Marked
issues.description: AuditorAgent role definition mandates NECESSARY pattern (N: Normal, E: Edge, C: Corner, E: Error, S: Security, S: Stress, A: Accessibility, R: Regression, Y: Yield). Zero tests use @pytest.mark.necessary marker.
issues.recommendation: IMMEDIATE ACTION: 1) Add @pytest.mark.necessary('N') to all normal tests, 2) Audit for missing E/C/S categories, 3) Add pytest marker validation in conftest.py.
issues.production_risk: CRITICAL - Cannot measure NECESSARY compliance (constitutional violation)

issues.title: NECESSARY COMMENTS MISSING: 0 Code References
issues.description: Grep search for '# NECESSARY:' comments returned 0 results. Tests lack categorical documentation.
issues.recommendation: Add # NECESSARY: N/E/C/E/S/S/A/R/Y comments to test docstrings or inline for traceability.
issues.production_risk: HIGH - Cannot audit test completeness per NECESSARY categories

issues.title: SECURITY TESTS: Weak Coverage
issues.description: Only 1 security test file found (test_anthropic_memory_security.py). No SQL injection, XSS, path traversal tests for tools/orchestrator/ or agency_memory/.
issues.recommendation: Create tests/security/test_input_validation.py covering: 1) SQL injection attempts, 2) Path traversal (../../etc/passwd), 3) Command injection in bash/git tools.
issues.production_risk: CRITICAL - Security vulnerabilities could expose system

issues.title: STRESS TESTS: Insufficient Load Coverage
issues.description: Only 1 stress test file (tests/stress/test_async_memory_stress.py). No tests validate 1000+ task graphs, 100+ concurrent agents, or VectorStore at 1M+ patterns.
issues.recommendation: Create tests/stress/test_orchestrator_load.py: 1) 1000-task graph execution, 2) 100 concurrent agents, 3) VectorStore with 1M patterns.
issues.production_risk: MEDIUM - System may fail under production load

issues.title: EDGE CASE TESTS: Implicit, Not Explicit
issues.description: Edge cases tested (empty files, whitespace-only input) but not marked with @pytest.mark.necessary('E'). Makes auditing impossible.
examples: tests/orchestrator/test_necessary_validator.py validates NECESSARY but doesn't USE markers
issues.recommendation: Retrofit @pytest.mark.necessary('E') to all TestEdgeCases class methods. Use grep to find them.
issues.production_risk: LOW - Edge cases tested, just not categorized

findings_by_category.summary: Logical directory structure, strong fixture usage, some test file bloat

issues.title: TEST FILE BLOAT: 9 Files Exceed 1,000 Lines
issues.description: 9 test files exceed 1,000 lines (max: 1,732). Large files reduce maintainability and violate 'Focused Functions' principle.
issues.recommendation: Split into multiple files: test_chief_architect_agent_creation.py, test_chief_architect_agent_audits.py, test_chief_architect_agent_adr_generation.py.
issues.production_risk: LOW - Maintainability issue, not functional

issues.title: CONFTEST FIXTURE SPRAWL: 81 Fixtures Across 6 Files
issues.description: 81 fixtures defined across 6 conftest.py files. Some duplication detected (mock_agent_context appears in 3 places).
issues.recommendation: Consolidate shared fixtures into tests/fixtures/shared.py, import in conftest. Document fixture dependencies.
issues.production_risk: LOW - Maintainability issue

issues.title: DIRECTORY NESTING: tests/tests/ Redundancy
issues.description: Found tests/tests/e2e/ directory (double nesting). Likely migration artifact.
issues.recommendation: Move tests/tests/e2e/ → tests/e2e/ and remove empty tests/tests/.
issues.production_risk: LOW - Cosmetic issue

issues.title: MARKER USAGE INCONSISTENCY: 25 Markers, Selective Use
issues.description: pytest.ini defines 25 markers (unit, integration, e2e, smoke, slow, etc.) but usage is inconsistent. No smoke marker found in tests despite pytest.ini definition.
issues.recommendation: Audit all tests for marker compliance: 1) Add @pytest.mark.smoke to critical path tests, 2) Mark slow tests (>1s) with @pytest.mark.slow.
issues.production_risk: MEDIUM - Can't selectively run critical tests for rapid TDD feedback

findings_by_category.summary: Tactical coverage strong (unit/integration), strategic coverage weak (workflows/E2E)

issues.title: NO CODE COVERAGE METRICS: Unknown Actual Coverage
issues.description: No pytest-cov usage detected. 5,804 passing tests but unknown % of source code covered. Could be 50% or 95%.
issues.recommendation: IMMEDIATE: Install pytest-cov, run pytest --cov=. --cov-report=html. Target: >90% coverage for shared/, >80% for tools/, >70% for agents/.
issues.production_risk: CRITICAL - Dead code and untested paths unknown

issues.title: GIT WORKTREE WORKFLOW: Zero Tests
issues.description: CLAUDE.md documents git worktree isolation for autonomous agents (key feature), but no tests validate worktree creation, cleanup, or branch isolation.
issues.recommendation: Create tests/tools/test_git_worktree_isolation.py: 1) Create worktree, 2) Isolated file operations, 3) Cleanup after merge.
issues.production_risk: HIGH - Worktree isolation failures could corrupt repository

issues.title: DOCKER COMPOSE OLLAMA: Skipped Integration
issues.description: 164 tests skipped, many for SKIP_OLLAMA_TESTS=1. Docker Compose setup documented but integration tests skipped by default.
issues.recommendation: CI should run with SKIP_OLLAMA_TESTS=0 to validate Docker integration. Add tests/integration/test_docker_compose_lifecycle.py.
issues.production_risk: MEDIUM - Local model integration could break silently

issues.title: BACKLOG AUTO-SELECTION: Partial Coverage
issues.description: CLAUDE.md documents /primeccc auto-selection from TOP 5 PRIORITY QUEUE, but only 7 tests in test_foundation_automation_backlog.py.
issues.recommendation: Add tests for: 1) Priority parsing ([P1]/[P2]/[P3]), 2) Status filtering ([Ready]/[Blocked]/[Done]), 3) Malformed backlog handling.
issues.production_risk: MEDIUM - Auto-selection bugs would block autonomous execution

issues.title: TWO-STAGE WORKFLOW: Checkpoint Gaps
issues.description: Leap 7 introduces --two-stage flag with approval checkpoint, but only 28 tests in test_primea_two_stage.py. Checkpoint UI and approval logic untested.
issues.recommendation: Add tests/orchestrator/test_approval_checkpoint.py: 1) User rejects spec, 2) User requests revision, 3) Timeout handling.
issues.production_risk: MEDIUM - Checkpoint failures could bypass human review

final_verdict.summary: PASS WITH RESERVATIONS - Suite demonstrates strong tactical testing (unit/integration) but critical strategic gaps in E2E workflows, constitutional enforcement, and NECESSARY compliance.

No code coverage metrics (unknown dead code exposure)
Missing primeccc E2E tests (primary workflow untested)
Weak Article IV enforcement (VectorStore learning gaps)

final_verdict.confidence: HIGH - Audit based on 292 files, 5,804 tests, 156k LOC analyzed. Findings are evidence-based.
